systems.system: Unified Digital Civil Registration Service: link to education services
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation
systems.tiers: interfaces to health, education, national ID and immigration services under test at August 2025, not in operation; the Federal Ministry of Education has committed to piloting civil registration within school enrolment, starting with primary-age children who missed registration

note: Civil registration pilot in 19 districts; names no school records system. The only education content is a planned interface and a ministry commitment to a pilot at enrolment, logged as exchange.
